description: This file defines a class Handler within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Helper namespace. The class includes static methods for handling various types of PHP error conditions and other utility functions, such as suppressing errors, triggering deprecation warnings, setting timezone, and checking file contents.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle errors, warnings, notices, and deprecation messages within the PhpSpreadsheet Helper namespace.

methods.name: suppressed
methods.description: Returns whether an error suppression is successful by triggering and capturing an error.

methods.name: deprecated
methods.description: Returns a hexadecimal conversion of a static invalid hex character, demonstrating deprecated function usage.

methods.name: notice
methods.description: Sets the default timezone based on the provided string parameter.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Checks if a specific file can be read, used here to simulate handling of warnings.
